data.job_description:
A listed NBFC is hiring a senior leader for the CFO's office, at CFO-minus-one, with board and promoter-level visibility. The seat combines the inorganic agenda and the investor-facing narrative.

Key responsibilities:
Own the inorganic agenda end to end: M&A;, private equity, demerger, divestment, restructuring, joint ventures and strategic investments
Set the target screening framework and maintain a live pipeline across lending, housing and allied businesses
Own the full quarterly earnings cycle - investor presentation, press release, financial supplement, guidance framing and consensus bridges
Prepare and support the CFO and MD for earnings calls; handle investor and analyst questions directly
Build and lead a small, high-calibre team across corporate finance and IR
Act as a trusted second voice to the CFO on capital structure, fundraise strategy and shareholder matters.

Must have:
A personal, verifiable deal sheet of three or more transactions led or co-led, OR ownership of the earnings cycle at a listed company.
Relocation to Pune with family is required; full relocation support is provided.
CA, MBA (Finance) from a Tier 1 institute, or CFA.
Combinations preferred. Minimum 8 years specifically in corporate finance, M&A; or investor relations.

Job Description – Lead Finance & Accounts

Youthville | Pune, Maharashtra | Full-Time | 6 Days Working

Lead – Finance & Accounts

Pune, Maharashtra

6 Days Working | Work from Office

Experience: 5+ years, including leadership experience

About Youthville

Youthville is a hospitality and managed-living venture of the Kohinoor Group, focused on providing premium, comfortable and community-driven accommodation experiences. With an expanding presence in Pune and ambitions to grow its footprint across Pune and Mumbai, Youthville is building a scalable, professionally managed accommodation business.

At Youthville, we believe that great experiences for residents begin with strong systems, operational excellence and a committed team. As we continue to grow, we are looking for experienced finance professionals who can strengthen our financial foundation, drive process excellence and contribute to the company's long-term business growth.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualified Lead – Finance & Accounts to take complete ownership of the finance and accounting function at Youthville.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a finance professional who has worked in a startup or high-growth business environment and can independently manage end-to-end finance operations, financial planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, cash flow, audits and management reporting.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical accounting expertise with business acumen, leadership capabilities and the ability to build scalable financial systems in a growing organisation.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Finance & Accounting

Take complete ownership of the finance and accounts function across the organisation.

Oversee day-to-day accounting, general ledger, journal entries, reconciliations and month-end and year-end closures.

Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, including the Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement.

Establish robust accounting policies, internal controls and standard operating procedures.

Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, vendor payments, customer collections, advances and accruals.

Monitor financial transactions across properties, departments and business entities.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Analysis

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.

Prepare monthly MIS reports, variance analysis and financial dashboards for management.

Analyse revenue, operating costs, property-level profitability and business performance.

Monitor key financial indicators, cost efficiency and profitability across locations.

Provide actionable financial insights to management for strategic and operational decisions.

Support business expansion plans through financial modelling, feasibility analysis and investment evaluation.

3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

Manage direct and indirect taxation, including income tax, GST, TDS and applicable statutory compliances.

Ensure timely filing of returns, payment of taxes and reconciliation of statutory records.

Oversee tax audits, statutory audits, internal audits and other regulatory requirements.

Coordinate with external consultants, auditors, banks and regulatory authorities.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws and corporate regulations.

Monitor compliance requirements across relevant legal entities and business operations.

4. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Manage daily cash flow, liquidity planning and working capital requirements.

Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate funds for business operations.

Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor settlements and collection cycles.

Develop controls for payment approvals, expense management and fund utilisation.

Maintain banking relationships and support financing requirements wherever applicable.

5. Internal Controls & Process Automation

Develop and implement strong financial controls and approval mechanisms.

Identify opportunities to automate accounting, reporting and finance workflows.

Improve financial processes, documentation, reconciliation and audit readiness.

Implement standardised finance practices across properties and business units.

Work with cross-functional teams to ensure financial discipline and process compliance.

6. Leadership & Business Partnering

Lead, mentor and develop the finance and accounts team.

Establish clear responsibilities, performance standards and reporting timelines.

Partner with business leaders, operations, sales, procurement and management teams.

Work closely with senior management on financial strategy, risk management and business planning.

Support new property launches, expansion projects, commercial evaluations and financial due diligence.

Build a proactive finance function that supports business growth rather than merely recording transactions.

Candidate Requirements

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) qualified — mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated leadership or team-management experience.

Startup exposure: Prior experience working in a startup, scale-up or high-growth organisation is strongly preferred.

Strong expertise in end-to-end accounting, taxation, financial reporting, budgeting, MIS and cash flow management.

Experience managing audits, statutory compliances and multiple business operations or entities.

Ability to independently lead the finance function and establish processes from the ground up.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Proficiency in accounting systems, Excel and financial reporting tools; experience with ERP or cloud-based accounting platforms is an advantage.

A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

Why Join Youthville?

Be Part of a Growing Business

Join an expanding managed-accommodation venture and contribute to building the financial backbone of a growing hospitality business.

End-to-End Ownership

Lead the complete finance and accounting function, with the opportunity to shape processes, controls, reporting systems and financial strategy.

Direct Management Exposure

Work closely with senior leadership and contribute to key business decisions, expansion planning and operational improvements.
Build and Improve Systems

Create scalable financial processes and introduce automation, stronger controls and data-driven decision-making.
Entrepreneurial Work Environment

Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where initiative, accountability and practical problem-solving matter.

Compensation & Employment Details

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a finance leader who has moved beyond routine accounting and is ready to take complete ownership of a growing organisation's financial operations. Someone who understands startup realities, builds processes without excessive supervision, maintains financial discipline and translates financial data into meaningful business decisions.

If you are a qualified CA with startup experience and a passion for building scalable finance functions, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation & Employment Details

Particulars Details

Designation Lead – Finance & Accounts
Company Youthville

Location Pune, Maharashtra

CTC ₹18–20 LPA

Work Schedule 6 days a week

Work Mode Work from Office

Qualification CA Qualified

Experience 5+ years with leadership experience

Employment Type Full-Time

Apply Now

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and a brief overview of their leadership and startup experience.

Email: hr@youthvillehostel.com

Company: Living Timeless

Location: Pune

Industry: Modular Furniture / Interior Manufacturing

Employment Type: Full-time

Living Timeless is looking for a commercially strong Accountant / Finance Executive who can manage core accounting while also owning P&L visibility, MIS, project profitability, cash flow, receivables, payables, and cost control.

This is not a pure bookkeeping role. We need someone who can convert accounting data into clear financial insights for management.

Key Responsibilities
• Maintain complete and accurate books of accounts
• Prepare and review monthly P&L statements
• Build project-wise and showroom-wise P&L
• Track revenue, COGS, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and profitability
• Analyse budget vs actual performance
• Identify margin leakage, cost overruns and unusual expenses
• Track project-level:
• Revenue booked
• Collections
• Material cost
• Manufacturing cost
• Installation cost
• Logistics
• Discounts
• Rework / snag costs
• Gross profit
• Contribution margin
• Prepare weekly and monthly management MIS
• Maintain cash-flow forecasts and upcoming payment requirements
• Track customer receivables and ageing
• Track vendor payables and payment schedules
• Monitor purchase advances and vendor reconciliations
• Perform bank reconciliations
• Manage GST, TDS and statutory accounting requirements
• Coordinate with CA and auditors
• Verify purchase invoices, POs and payment approvals
• Track factory, showroom and corporate overheads separately
• Maintain machinery, fixed-asset and capex accounting
• Support payroll, incentives and reimbursements
• Develop financial controls to prevent duplicate, incorrect or unauthorized payments

P&L Ownership The person should be comfortable preparing and explaining:
Revenue

Less: Material / Procurement Cost
Less: Manufacturing Cost

Less: Installation & Logistics

= Gross Profit

Less: Sales & Marketing

Less: Showroom Expenses

Less: Factory Overheads

Less: Salaries & Admin

= EBITDA

They should be able to clearly explain why profitability moved month-on-month, not simply produce the report.

Management Reporting

Expected reporting should include
• Monthly consolidated P&L
• Project-wise profitability
• Showroom-wise profitability
• Factory cost report
• Gross-margin trends
• Marketing spend vs revenue
• Payroll as % of revenue
• Fixed vs variable costs
• Receivable ageing
• Payable ageing
• Cash-flow forecast
• Budget vs actual
• Capex tracker
• Revenue booked vs revenue collected
• Upcoming financial liabilities
What We Expect
We want someone who proactively flags:

“Gross margin has dropped from 42% to 35% this month.”

“This project has exceeded its installation budget.”

“Material cost on this category is running above target.”

“₹X is receivable but overdue.”

“Factory overhead has increased faster than revenue.”

“This showroom is generating revenue but is not yet contribution-positive.”

“Based on upcoming vendor payments and collections, we will require ₹X cash over the next 30 days.”

Candidate Profile
• B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance / equivalent
• 3–6+ years of relevant experience
• Strong understanding of P&L, MIS, cost accounting and financial analysis
• Strong Excel skills
• Experience with Tally / ERP systems
• Strong understanding of GST and TDS
• Experience in manufacturing, furniture, interiors, construction or project-based businesses preferred
• Comfortable working directly with founders and senior management
• Strong attention to detail with a commercial mindset
Most Important Trait
We are not looking for someone who only asks:

“Has this invoice been entered?”

We want someone who also asks:

“Why did we spend this money, which project does it belong to, what margin are we making, and what does this do to the P&L?”
•

Cloudwerx is growing, and so is our Finance team.

As our business continues to evolve across multiple entities and regions, we’re looking for a Senior Accountant to join Cloudwerx and help strengthen the financial foundations that support our growth.

This isn’t a role focused only on month-end reporting.

We’re looking for someone who can bring strong accounting fundamentals while also working across financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow, payroll support, statutory compliance, internal controls and business partnering.

Location: Pune, India

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Delivery, Sales & Marketing, People & Culture and our leadership team, helping turn financial information into meaningful insights and supporting better business decisions.

What you’ll be responsible for

• Managing month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities

• Preparing management accounts, financial statements and leadership reporting

• Supporting multi-entity and multi-currency consolidations

• Preparing balance sheet, bank and intercompany reconciliations

• Supporting budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow planning

• Supporting Australian, New Zealand and India payroll activities

• Coordinating statutory compliance and external audit requirements

• Strengthening internal financial controls and governance

• Partnering with teams across the business on financial analysis and decision-making

• Identifying opportunities to automate, simplify and improve Finance processes

What we’re looking for

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Commerce, Finance or a related discipline

• 5+ years of relevant accounting experience

• Strong financial reporting and month-end experience

• Sound knowledge of IFRS/accounting standards and statutory compliance

• Experience with reconciliations, journals, budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow management

• Strong Excel capability and experience with cloud-based accounting or ERP systems

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and professional judgement

CA, CPA or equivalent qualifications are highly regarded, along with experience in multi-entity, multi-currency or international environments.

Experience working across Australia, New Zealand and India, or with platforms such as Xero, Zoho or Fathom, would also be valuable.

Why Cloudwerx?

Cloudwerx works at the intersection of AI, data, CRM, integration, automation and digital transformation, helping organisations turn technology into practical business outcomes.

As Cloudwerx continues to grow and our operations become more complex, we’re investing in a Finance function that can do more than report the numbers — one that can provide strong controls, useful insights and the financial foundation needed to support what comes next.

If you’re an experienced accountant who enjoys combining strong financial discipline with commercial thinking and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Overview:

The Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team supports the Mizuho U.S. Operations (MUSO) risk management framework through risk governance, analytics, controls, reporting and execution. Mizuho Pune is being developed as an integrated extension of the global NFR and wider Risk organization, providing scalable, follow-the-sun risk management capabilities across MUSO’s Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB).

The NFR Analyst / Associate will be part of the Pune NFR capability and will support the NFR India Lead in delivering high-quality risk governance, reporting, analytics, review and challenge, issue tracking, and stakeholder support. The role is suited for a developing risk professional who can work with data, processes and stakeholders to identify risk themes, improve transparency, and support timely escalation and remediation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the build-out and ongoing operation of the NFR capability in Mizuho Pune, working closely with the NFR India Lead and global NFR stakeholders.
• Assist with first-level review of key NFR information, including risk appetite metrics, risk events, RCSA outputs, KRIs, control indicators and management information.
• Analyze risk data to identify trends, anomalies, recurring issues and areas that may require management attention or further review.
• Support RCSA transformation, quality assurance activities and review of areas where risks may be under-assessed or where control outcomes indicate emerging concerns.
• Prepare, maintain and enhance recurring NFR reporting, dashboards, governance materials and management information to support risk oversight and decision-making.
• Track actions, issues, escalations and remediation plans to support timely closure and effective management visibility.
• Partner with teams across MUSO Risk, Business, Operations and Technology to gather inputs, validate information, challenge data and follow up on open items.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring reporting, control and governance processes.
• Support the controlled use of analytics, automation and AI-enabled approaches to improve risk identification, reporting quality and process efficiency, ensuring outputs remain explainable and auditable.
• Contribute to a strong risk culture within the Pune NFR team by demonstrating ownership, attention to detail and constructive challenge.

Experience & Skills:

Required:

• 5–12 years of experience in Non-Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Controls, Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Reporting or a related risk management function within a financial institution.
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
• Good understanding of RCSA, risk events, KRIs, risk appetite, controls, issues management and operational risk governance.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess risk data, identify patterns and translate findings into clear and actionable commentary.
• Experience preparing management information, dashboards, governance packs or risk reporting materials.
• Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset and ability to manage recurring deliverables accurately and on time.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to present risk information clearly and work effectively across regions and functions.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with workflow, reporting or analytics tools is beneficial.

Preferred:

• Experience supporting CIB, Markets, Banking or Treasury businesses.
• Exposure to global or follow-the-sun operating models, including India-based risk or controls teams.
• Experience with RCSA transformation, controls testing, risk analytics, reporting automation or process improvement initiatives.
• Familiarity with data visualization, automation or AI-enabled risk reporting tools.

Success in the Role:

Success will be measured by the ability to provide reliable analytical and execution support to the Pune NFR capability, deliver accurate and timely risk reporting, contribute to effective review and challenge, maintain strong tracking of issues and actions, and help simplify, standardize and automate recurring NFR processes. The individual should operate as a trusted member of the NFR India team and help strengthen connectivity between Pune, MUSO Risk and global NFR stakeholders.
